import json
c=json.load(open('/tmp/fbt_cache.json'))

for p in ps:

    o=om[p['order_id']]; e=p['entry']; R=p['R']; s=1 if p['side']=='long' else -1

    # candle index containing placed_t-60000 .. placed_t
    idx=[i for i,x in enumerate(cs) if x[0]>=o['placed_t']-60000-60000 and x[0]<=o['placed_t']]
